title: The FarmTree Platform
excerpt: Design, compare and communicate agroforestry scenarios with connected scientific, environmental and economic project intelligence.

title: Privacy Policy
excerpt: How the FarmTree website handles personal information.
introduction: FarmTree B.V. respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal data in a transparent and responsible manner.
This Privacy Policy explains what information may be processed when you visit farmtree.eu, why it is processed and what rights you may have.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs:
FarmTree B.V.
Plus Ultra Building
Bronland 12C-1
6708 WH Wageningen
The Netherlands
Email: info@farmtree.earth
FarmTree B.V. is the entity identified on farmtree.eu. This notice describes the website-related processing associated with farmtree.eu.

sections.heading: Information processed when you visit the website
paragraphs: FarmTree does not currently use public behavioural analytics, advertising pixels or visitor-profiling technologies on farmtree.eu.
When you access the website, technical request information may nevertheless be processed by the hosting infrastructure. This may include:
items: date and time of the request
technical information required to deliver and protect the website
after: The hosting environment uses Apache access logs and AWStats for technical and aggregate website statistics.
This information is processed for website delivery, security, troubleshooting, availability and technical performance.

sections.heading: Contacting FarmTree
paragraphs: The current website uses an email-based contact experience.
When you select a contact or quotation action, your own email application may open and allow you to send a message to info@farmtree.earth.
The website itself does not currently submit or store contact-form entries in the FarmTree WordPress database.
The reviewed website has no newsletter subscription, and comments are closed on all nine News posts.

If you email FarmTree, the information you choose to provide may be used to respond to your request, communicate with you and, where relevant, take steps related to a potential or existing business relationship.

sections.heading: Accounts and authentication
paragraphs: farmtree.eu does not currently provide public account registration.

WordPress authentication functionality exists for authorised website administration and controlled access. When an authorised user signs in, WordPress may process authentication information and set strictly necessary login and session cookies.
These cookies are used for authentication and security.

sections.heading: Cookies and local browser storage
paragraphs: At the date of this Privacy Policy, an ordinary anonymous visit to the public website does not set advertising or behavioural-tracking cookies.

The FarmTree Native interface may use browser session storage for presentation purposes, such as remembering whether a visual metric animation has already been displayed during the browser session. This storage does not contain information entered by the visitor.
WordPress authentication cookies are used only when login or controlled-access functionality is used.

No cookie banner is currently present. If FarmTree introduces analytics, marketing or other non-essential cookies in the future, this Privacy Policy and, where legally required, the consent mechanism will be updated before those technologies are enabled.

sections.heading: Hosting and technical services
paragraphs: The website is hosted using Vimexx infrastructure on a network registered in the Netherlands.
Hosting systems process technical request information needed to provide, secure, maintain and troubleshoot the website.

The production WordPress installation also uses administrative and backup integrations supplied through the hosting environment. Extendify Insights and SeedProd usage telemetry are disabled in the reviewed configuration.

sections.heading: External websites and services
paragraphs: farmtree.eu contains links to external websites and services, including the FarmTree Platform, LinkedIn, YouTube, OpenStreetMap and third-party information sources.
The FarmTree website does not embed those services or automatically transmit form data to the FarmTree Platform in the reviewed configuration.
When you follow an external link, you leave farmtree.eu and the privacy practices of the destination service apply.
The FarmTree Platform is currently accessed through links to tool.farmtree.earth.

sections.heading: Artificial intelligence features
paragraphs: FarmTree has technical components that may support an AI assistant in the future.
The FarmTree AI Assistant is currently disabled.

No public AI widget is rendered, conversation logging is disabled, no conversation history is stored and visitor information is not currently sent by this website to OpenAI, Anthropic or another AI provider.
If such functionality is activated in the future, the applicable privacy information will be updated before public use.

sections.heading: Team and professional information
paragraphs: The website contains professional information about FarmTree team members, including names, roles, biographies, photographs and links to professional profiles.
This information is presented as organisational and professional information about the FarmTree team.

sections.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Depending on the processing activity, FarmTree processes personal data where this is necessary:
items: to operate, secure and maintain the website
for FarmTree's legitimate interests in communicating about its organisation, services and activities
to respond to enquiries and take steps requested by a person before entering into a business relationship
to comply with applicable legal obligations
where another legal basis under applicable data-protection law applies
after: FarmTree does not currently use this website for automated decision-making or visitor profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: FarmTree does not state fixed retention periods in this Privacy Policy because no fixed periods were established by the website runtime audit.

The reviewed runtime currently stores authorised WordPress account and session information and team profile information. The hosting environment stores access-log and AWStats information and may retain website backups.
Email sent directly to info@farmtree.earth is handled outside the farmtree.eu WordPress database.
FarmTree retains personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was processed, including applicable technical, security, business and legal requirements.

sections.heading: Data security
paragraphs: FarmTree uses technical and organisational measures intended to protect website and account information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse or alteration.
No internet-based system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Where the GDPR applies, you may have rights concerning your personal data, including rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and, where applicable, data portability.
You may contact FarmTree regarding a privacy request at info@farmtree.earth.
FarmTree may need to verify your identity before responding to certain requests.
You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.

sections.heading: External links and international processing
paragraphs: The reviewed website configuration does not automatically load third-party fonts, maps, videos, analytics scripts or other third-party browser resources from FarmTree Native pages.
If you choose to follow an external link, the destination service receives the request and may process information outside the European Economic Area under its own privacy arrangements.

sections.heading: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: FarmTree may update this Privacy Policy when the website, services, technology or applicable requirements change.
The current version will be published on farmtree.eu with its latest revision date.
